verdict.rationale: Airwallex is a spend-management and corporate-card platform, so in-platform travel booking with policy applied at booking time is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions flight or hotel booking. The closest evidence describes spend rules applied when expense reports are audited and card spend limits. That is post-hoc expense checking and an adjacent control, not policy enforced at the moment of booking.

support.subject: As an employee, I can book flights and hotels in-platform with travel policy applied at booking time, not expensed and argued about later
